_comment: Google News RSS queries for scripts/feed_sweep.py. Each runs as one free RSS request, 100 results max, no web-search budget. 'when:1d' is added automatically for the window; site: queries sweep one outlet, topic queries sweep the categories, mention queries find Inception42 and executive coverage.

outlets.Reuters: site:reuters.com (AI OR "artificial intelligence" OR chips OR Nvidia OR OpenAI)
